LIVE SEASON · Y11S3.1
Operation Split Fire is live. Patch facts here follow Ubisoft’s Y11S3.1 notes.

The Y11S3.1 update (September 22, 2026) retuned Buck, Castle, Fenrir, Maestro, Thermite and Sledge, raised M1014 and SPAS-15 damage, and fixed several Noor Horus Lance interactions. The workbook teaches habits rather than patch numbers, and every edition states the season and patch it was reviewed

text:
Castle kit at a glance
Side: Defense
Role: Choke Denial
Gadget: Armor Panel
Primary: UMP45 / M1014
Secondary: MAGNUM

label: desktop
name: operator-castle-counter
text: On attack: bring soft-breach (Sledge, Buck, Zofia) for any Castle-banned site. As of Y11S3.1 an Armor Panel takes 10 melee hits to destroy (was 9).

name: operator-sledge-gadget
text: A breaching hammer that breaks soft walls and floors up close. Each swing takes 0.8 seconds as of Y11S3.1 (was 1 second). 25 charges per round — effectively unlimited.
